meta_description: Done-for-you referral intake and follow-up for specialty practices, so more inbound referrals turn into scheduled appointments.
for_whom: For specialty practices with inbound referrals, like PT, ortho, derm, imaging, GI, and medspa groups
hero_headline: Turn inbound referrals into scheduled appointments before they leak
hero_subheadline: We run the referral-to-scheduled workflow: intake, missing-doc chase, patient outreach, and status reporting for busy specialty practices.
secondary_cta_text: See a sample referral leakage report
credibility_line: Minimum-necessary access. BAA-friendly process. You control final patient communication rules.
pain_paragraph: Referral volume leaks when faxed or emailed referrals sit unworked, missing documents are never chased down, and patients do not get contacted fast enough. The result is lost appointments, idle provider capacity, and frustrated referring offices that stop trusting your process.
before: Referrals pile up across fax, email, and sticky-note workflows
Nobody can quickly tell which patients were called or what is still missing
Referring offices keep resending paperwork or asking for updates
Booked visits depend on whoever at the front desk is least overloaded
after: Every referral lands in one tracked queue with a clear status
Missing docs are chased with a repeatable checklist
Patients get contacted fast with a simple outreach cadence
You see twice-weekly leakage and booked-appointment reporting
offer_summary: ReferralFlow Desk is a done-for-you referral conversion workflow for one location. We log inbound referrals, chase missing paperwork, follow up with patients, and keep the queue moving until each referral is scheduled, declined, or clearly blocked.
included: Shared referral tracker with status taxonomy and owner fields
Inbound referral logging from fax, email, or uploaded batches
Missing-doc follow-up templates for referring offices
Patient outreach cadence and call/text/email script recommendations
Twice-weekly status summary with booked, blocked, and leaked referrals
Simple leakage report with top failure reasons
excluded: Insurance authorization, billing, or coding work
Handling emergencies or after-hours patient care
Deep EHR customization or multi-location rollout in starter tier
process: 15-minute fit call to confirm specialty, referral volume, and workflow constraints
Week 1 setup: tracker, status categories, outreach rules, and intake path
Daily/weekly ops: log referrals, chase missing items, and contact patients
Twice-weekly review: booked count, blockers, leakage reasons, and next fixes
pricing_headline: Starter: $1,000 to $1,500 per location per month
pricing_details: Best for one location with a defined referral inbox and moderate volume. Higher-volume locations or multi-channel intake are custom. Pilot offer: 2-week referral cleanup + leakage report for $400, credited toward month 1.
guarantee_line: If we do not identify at least 10 actionable referral bottlenecks or booked-opportunity saves in the pilot, we keep working for one extra week at no charge.

faq.q: How do you handle security and patient data?
faq.a: We use minimum-necessary access only, work inside your approved systems where possible, and can follow a BAA process when required. We do not need broad production access or clinical records beyond what is needed to move the referral workflow.

faq.q: What needs to be in place before we start?
faq.a: You need one clear referral intake path, one internal owner for escalations, and basic outreach rules for contacting patients and referring offices. We can work with fax, email, or exports, but the starter tier works best when the volume is manageable and the workflow is not spread across multiple locations.
Usually 3 to 5 business days for one location. We set up the tracker, agree on statuses and scripts, and start with a live referral batch so the team sees value quickly.
By default, we retain only what is needed for active work and reporting. We can follow a shorter retention window, deletion request process, and your preferred export/archive rules.

trust_basics_line: Not clinical advice. Not billing or insurance authorization. We operate the referral workflow and reporting layer only.
